name: slurm-devcontainer
description: Develop inside Apptainer containers running as Slurm jobs on HPC clusters, similar to Dev Containers.

slurmDevcontainer.sshPath.description: Path to the local ssh executable used to run commands on the cluster login node.

slurmDevcontainer.openInNewWindow.description: Open the container in a new window instead of replacing the current one.

slurmDevcontainer.connectTimeoutMinutes.description: How long to wait for the Slurm job to start and the container to become ready.

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
